The buildings on the far left seem slightly warped or inconsistently scaled relative to the hills, suggesting minor depth/compositing issues.
The faces have a 'waxy' or over-smoothed appearance typical of AI generation, lacking natural skin pore detail and showing slight asymmetry in eye shapes.
